dimensions.name: Cohort and retention correctness
dimensions.description: Returns every eligible cohort with the correct user and exact week-one retained-user counts.
evidence_required: correct public and hidden result sets
strong_indicators: eligible cohort population is defined before activity joins
one retained row per user and cohort
weak_indicators: counts raw events rather than users

dimensions.name: Duplicate and eligibility handling
dimensions.description: Prevents at-least-once source delivery, repeated sessions, test accounts, and non-qualifying events from changing retention incorrectly.
strong_indicators: retained users are reduced to one row before aggregation
weak_indicators: DISTINCT is applied only after an inflated aggregate
test users contribute to either denominator or numerator

dimensions.name: Query structure and maintainability
dimensions.description: Uses auditable stages, exact aliases, and deterministic output without unnecessary procedural work.
strong_indicators: CTEs or equivalent stages separate eligibility, activity, and aggregation
column names and order match the contract

dimensions.name: Production-scale reasoning
dimensions.description: Explains how the query behaves with late events and billion-row daily activity volume.
strong_indicators: partition pruning and incremental cohort recomputation are quantified
source-event replay is monitored as a correctness signal

score_bands.90-100: Exact results on all fixtures with clear duplicate semantics and credible production-scale reasoning.
score_bands.75-89: Correct cohort query with one minor edge-case or operational gap.
score_bands.60-74: Core aggregation is partially correct but mishandles duplicates, empty cohorts, or boundaries.
score_bands.0-59: Incorrect retention definition or materially inflated/dropped results.
